data.completion_memo: Implemented the v1 QA system from the formal design. Added project-local QA job definitions, design/task links, tags, immutable run groups and per-job evidence, derived job state, synchronous Rust execution with timeout/output capture, Tauri dashboard commands, MCP QA tools, seeded default QA jobs, and a full Dashboard QA workspace with filters, editing, run actions, history, and console output. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml, cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml, npm run build outside the sandbox after the known esbuild spawn EPERM, and git diff --check.
data.description: Implement the v1 QA system exactly as captured in the formal design. Scope includes project-local QA job definitions; QA job design/task links and tags; derived job state from latest evidence plus staleness; immutable qa_runs execution groups; qa_job_runs per-job output/evidence; query-driven ad hoc batch runs without persisted batch-job definitions; Dashboard QA workspace with list/edit/delete/filter/run actions and integrated console output; shared Rust/Tauri execution runtime; and MCP tools to list/query/create/update/delete/run QA jobs and inspect run evidence. Do not introduce saved QA suites/batches in v1.
data.title: Implement v1 QA system from formal design
